newsitem.title: UK: UK water shares rise, Dresdner repeats "buy".
newsitem.headline: UK water shares rise, Dresdner repeats "buy".

text.p: British water companies' shares rose on Friday after Dresdner Kleinwort Benson reiterated its "buy" recommendation on the sector, dealers said.

Dresdner sees a 10 percent return of value on the sector, and says the sector is at least 10 percent undervalued. The brokerage sees Hyder Plc's financial structure as sound and picks out Anglian Water Plc, South West Water Plc , Thames Water Plc and United Utilities Plc as favoured stocks.

Hyder Plc put on four pence to 831-1/2p. The group said on Thursday it would pay for its share of a one-off tax on excess profits from borrowings, and also ruled out a legal challenge to the windfall tax, which was detailed in Chancellor Gordon Brown's budget statement last week.
Hyder said its share of the overall five billion stg tax would be 282 million stg. Market expectations were for around 230 million.
Anglian Water rose 17-1/2p to 751p, Thames Water three pence to 752p, United Utilities 14p to 718-1/2p and South West Water two pence to 772-1/2p.
